Right body poses, collision geometry and joint frames use the left side as authority while retaining the issue16 signed joint-coordinate reflection. Central COM y, odd inertia terms and joint anchors are projected onto sagittal symmetry; center collision convex hulls are clipped on the left and mirrored. Defaults, action scales and actuator PD/effort/velocity/friction settings are tabulated separately and remain unchanged. Physical tensors are compared in the authored world frame; actual PhysX readback is recorded separately. Collision point counts/topology changes alone do not measure cooked-hull distance or establish a causal contribution to heading.
